rules.requirement: Dashboard is read-only source aggregation; signed integer Toman, no invented cash transfer or global scope guarantee.

2..500 one-sided positive debit/credit lines with equal safe-integer totals, active postable accounts; occurred_at<=now+5min. Post draft only with reason; reverse posted once via compensating posted entry.

Create code/name/type/normal/optional parent/system key/postable. PATCH only name/parent/postable/active. Self-parent rejected; deeper cycle protection not certified. Deactivate route Step-Up; PATCH is_active has different source metadata.

Draft cost with nonnegative integer amount and four treatments; item requires order, campaign/order exclusive. Capitalization pair required at finalization. Reverse original finalized once, preserves amount with negative effect sign.

Finalization needs fresh provisional fingerprint, settled payment/refunds and no draft cost; existing final replays. Rules must resolve unambiguously to one rule for all items. Reversal compensates distribution; not money movement.

Four-decimal percentage units sum exactly100; global/category/brand/product scope, priority and ordered effective interval. Full input draft-only update; active expiration; split signed integer Toman conserves total. Preview remains frozen NO_ACTION.
Distributions read-only with signed reversal evidence; no settlement or payout command.

Run is synchronous snapshot saved completed; cancel only queued/running. Export csv/json from completed job, download JSON envelope with content. No requester binding, cache headers or formula neutralization guarantee inferred.
Read projections with sourceWatermark; operations from<=to<=asOf, bounded500. No runtime repair action or fresh-source guarantee.

Nine datasets, csv/json, owner-bound list/get/download; completed only. Idempotency actor/key/payload-bound; same-key failed replay not retry. Serializer allowlists columns, neutralizes CSV formulas,5MiB cap; private no-store download.

Basis points0..10000 integer. Draft-only PATCH; activate draft with matching version and same-scope interval exclusion; expire active. Scope immutable on PATCH. All three need If-Match, no idempotency decorator invented.

Registry typed values; direct PATCH low-risk/global only, but no current low-risk key. Preview advisory. Rollback takes history[0]/[1] across key, not chosen version or scoped history. No client expected version or scheduling guarantee.

Submitted approve/reject; requester-only cancel submitted/approved; apply approved. No added two-person rule; scheduled_for is stored transition metadata, not deferred job. Proposed value revalidated; not tied to preview snapshot.

Create boolean/variant with key/name/default/risk; PATCH metadata only. Preview target ids not persisted; rollout0..100, enable, disable, emergency disable to0, retire terminal. No version header or universal Step-Up on disable/emergency.
Only permissions/roles/role GET supported; role writes retain NO_ACTION. Existing role list may support staff assignment without granting role edit.

Staff create enrollment24h, recovery30min revokes credentials/sessions. Staff PATCH name/code only; role/scope replacement not additive, matching If-Match, no idempotency. Empty scope per type means global in ScopePolicy. Last-superadmin checks exist for disable/role removal, not universal race-proof protection.

Sessions list active max500; revoke single or staff sessions; staff account lock revokes, unlock does not restore. User-id routes use staffId, not accountId. No If-Match/idempotency or last-superadmin lock protection certified.

screens.title: نمای مالی
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Dashboard is read-only source aggregation; signed integer Toman, no invented cash transfer or global scope guarantee. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: سود سفارش و تاریخچهٔ محاسبه
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Finalization needs fresh provisional fingerprint, settled payment/refunds and no draft cost; existing final replays. Rules must resolve unambiguously to one rule for all items. Reversal compensates distribution; not money movement. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Four-decimal percentage units sum exactly100; global/category/brand/product scope, priority and ordered effective interval. Full input draft-only update; active expiration; split signed integer Toman conserves total. Preview remains frozen NO_ACTION. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: قواعد مالیات
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Basis points0..10000 integer. Draft-only PATCH; activate draft with matching version and same-scope interval exclusion; expire active. Scope immutable on PATCH. All three need If-Match, no idempotency decorator invented. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: درخواست تغییر تنظیمات
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Submitted approve/reject; requester-only cancel submitted/approved; apply approved. No added two-person rule; scheduled_for is stored transition metadata, not deferred job. Proposed value revalidated; not tied to preview snapshot. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: پرچم قابلیت
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Create boolean/variant with key/name/default/risk; PATCH metadata only. Preview target ids not persisted; rollout0..100, enable, disable, emergency disable to0, retire terminal. No version header or universal Step-Up on disable/emergency. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: کارکنان، دامنه و بازیابی کلید
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Staff create enrollment24h, recovery30min revokes credentials/sessions. Staff PATCH name/code only; role/scope replacement not additive, matching If-Match, no idempotency. Empty scope per type means global in ScopePolicy. Last-superadmin checks exist for disable/role removal, not universal race-proof protection. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: نشست‌ها و قفل و ابطال
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Sessions list active max500; revoke single or staff sessions; staff account lock revokes, unlock does not restore. User-id routes use staffId, not accountId. No If-Match/idempotency or last-superadmin lock protection certified. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: تاریخچهٔ استقرار
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Entire surface is a retained design obligation only. All operations, including reads, remain NO_ACTION until canonical reconciliation; no permission, public/customer fallback or executable lifecycle is inferred. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.title: کیفیت داده و بررسی مسئله
screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Entire surface is a retained design obligation only. All operations, including reads, remain NO_ACTION until canonical reconciliation; no permission, public/customer fallback or executable lifecycle is inferred. All actions retain frozen operation authority; no additional runtime or security guarantee is introduced.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

review.limits: Static320 equivalent only; runtime accessibility and actual400% zoom not certified.

acceptance.authority: 34 surfaces,185 operations;91 supported and94 NO_ACTION retained including profit preview and RBAC writes. Metadata is per-operation, not a uniform security guarantee.
acceptance.finance: Balanced integer-Toman journals and compensating reversals; fresh provisional profit and exact100 percent split; tax basis points/version/overlap. Finance export differs from analytics.
acceptance.configuration: Direct PATCH conditionally unavailable: no low-risk registry key. Advisory previews; requester cancel; rollback key-history first two across scopes; no future-worker claim.
acceptance.security: Full role/scope replacement with exact If-Match; empty scope means global. Account/staff/session ids distinct. Enrollment response secret only; no invented global last-superadmin protection.
acceptance.closure: G only; H NOT_STARTED; exact-head Canonical CI and Phase A plus post-merge checks required.
